OMIT rows: donor files left out by decision (nothing copied; blob pinned).

column4: immutable dense Boolean matrix as row-major long words: Builder.set/build, get, rowCardinality, setColumns (trusted int list view), transpose() in Java (dense 64x64 tiles through six word swaps when the first-tile probe and the per-tile population reach 256 bits, exact scalar bit visits otherwise), transpose(Backend.NATIVE_REQUIRED) as one whole-matrix JNI batch checked against the Java result before publication; java.util + java.nio.file only

C JNI kernel of the two natives nativeAbi0 (ABI 1) and transposeNative0: validates widths and lengths (NULL on refusal), GetLongArrayElements on the detached input snapshot and on the fresh output (input released with JNI_ABORT), the same first-tile probe, 64x64 broadword tile transpose and scalar fallback as the Java; __builtin_ctzll / __builtin_popcountll with portable fallbacks; includes <jni.h> directly (no javac -h header)

independent boolean[][] oracle main: dimensional boundary cases (0 x Integer.MAX_VALUE, negative dimensions, out-of-range set/get, NATIVE_REQUIRED without a library), 10 x 10 boundary shapes x 3 densities, 2,048 seeded random shapes up to 128 x 128; prints MAT_BIT_MATRIX_SCENARIOS / ASSERTIONS / BACKEND / RESULT; -Dm3.bitmatrix.requireNative=true adds the JNI parity lane, -Dm3.bitmatrix.expectMutant=true the corrupted-library refusal lane
